headline: Western allies moved in concert against Russia with the first joint EU-UK cyber sanctions and a shared critical-infrastructure router warning, as AI agents surfaced as both weapon and target in fresh attacks.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers and defenders alike now aim prompt injection at autonomous AI agents, with MemGhost quietly rewriting an assistant's memory through a single email while security teams turn the same trick to shut hacking bots down before they act.
emerging_trends.topic_title: MemGhost Plants False Memories in AI Agents

emerging_trends.text: Western governments squeezed Moscow in concert this week through joint EU-UK sanctions, a fresh critical-infrastructure advisory, and the naming of the FSB's Center 16 for sabotaging Poland's power grid and water plants.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Russia's FSB Blamed for Poland Grid Sabotage

emerging_trends.text: Microsoft 365 stays the prime quarry for credential thieves, with the rented Forg365 service and three linked Evilginx operations all built to hijack session tokens the moment a victim logs in.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Forg365 and Evilginx Kits Hunt Microsoft 365 Accounts

topics.title: Russia's FSB Blamed for Poland Grid Sabotage
topics.latest_developments: The Record reported July 12, 2026 that the allies pinned the FSB's signals-intelligence arm, Center 16, on attempted sabotage of Poland's energy sector and water-treatment facilities, and on July 13 CISA joined agencies from eight other countries in a warning that Russian state hackers are breaching critical infrastructure through vulnerable, poorly configured routers.
topics.summary: The European Union and United Kingdom on July 13, 2026 imposed their first joint cyber sanctions, 24 UK designations and 13 EU measures against Russian GRU officers and entities accused of spying and sabotage across Europe; operators should harden and patch internet-facing routers.

sources.title: Russia's FSB blamed for Poland grid attack as UK and EU impose first joint cyber sanctions
US and allies warn of Russian critical infrastructure attacks
EU sanctions Russian GRU military hackers over cyberattacks
EU and UK blacklist Russia's cyber operators over efforts to destabilize Europe

topics.title: Lidl and Centers Laboratory Breaches Expose Customers and Patients
topics.latest_developments: Lidl told shoppers in Germany, Belgium, and the Netherlands on July 13, 2026 that attackers stole their personal data through a service-provider breach, while the WorldLeaks extortion group claimed 720 GB from healthcare testing firm Centers Laboratory, exposing 540,000 individuals.
topics.summary: The two disclosures span retail and healthcare; affected shoppers and patients should watch for targeted phishing and identity fraud.

sources.title: Lidl discloses online shop breach after service provider hack
Centers Laboratory Data Breach Affects 540,000 Individuals

topics.title: MemGhost Plants False Memories in AI Agents
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News detailed MemGhost on July 13, 2026, an attack in which one email tricks a memory-equipped AI assistant into saving a false fact about its user, hides the change, and steers later answers, as Ars Technica reported defenders now use context bombing prompt injection to make hacking agents shut themselves down before they cause harm.
topics.summary: Memory-enabled AI assistants with inbox access hand attackers a persistent, invisible foothold; both attackers and defenders now weaponize prompt injection against autonomous agents.

sources.title: New MemGhost Attack Plants Persistent False Memories in AI Agents Through One Email
Now, defenders are embracing the prompt injection, too

topics.title: Forg365 and Evilginx Kits Hunt Microsoft 365 Accounts
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News on July 13, 2026 profiled Forg365, a $400-a-month phishing-as-a-service operation sold on Telegram that blends device-code phishing, adversary-in-the-middle session theft, antibot evasion, and AI-written lures, the same day French firm Lexfo unspooled three linked Evilginx phishing operations after an operator left a Python web server exposed with directory listing switched on.
topics.summary: Both toolkits target Microsoft 365 credentials and live sessions; defenders should enforce phishing-resistant authentication and hunt for stolen session-token reuse.

sources.title: Forg365 PhaaS Targets Microsoft 365 with Device Code and AitM Session Theft
Misconfigured Server Reveals Three Evilginx Phishing Operations Targeting Microsoft 365

topics.title: CISA Contractor Leaks Credentials on GitHub
topics.latest_developments: Krebs on Security reported July 13, 2026 that CISA issued a postmortem after a contractor published dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository, where they sat for nearly six months until KrebsOnSecurity notified the agency.
topics.summary: The exposed keys risked access to CISA's cloud environment; experts say the agency's slow initial response holds lessons on secret scanning and incident readiness that every security team should absorb.

sources.title: Lessons Learned from CISA's Recent GitHub Leak

topics.title: UK Charges Five Over Russian Coms Spoofing Platform
topics.latest_developments: UK authorities charged five people on July 13, 2026 following a National Crime Agency investigation into Russian Coms, a caller-ID spoofing platform criminals used to place more than 1.8 million scam calls.
topics.summary: Russian Coms let fraudsters mask their numbers to impersonate banks and officials; the charges mark a major strike against the spoofing-as-a-service market.

sources.title: UK charges suspects linked to Russian Coms call spoofing platform

business_politics.title: U.S. Reinstates Iran Blockade at Hormuz
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump said Monday, July 13, the United States is reinstating a naval blockade of Iran and will charge ships a 20% fee for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz, a fresh escalation after U.S. forces struck new Iranian targets and Tehran rejected the demand to reopen the waterway.
business_politics.summary: Trump declared Washington the guardian of the Strait of Hormuz and said it will bill vessels for security as fighting with Iran intensifies; oil futures climbed, gold fell 2.5%, Treasury yields rose, and Wall Street tech stocks sold off in a broad risk-off move, while Dubai announced plans for a new east-coast port to bypass the strait.

sources.title: Trump Says He Is Reimposing the U.S. Blockade of Iran
US will charge 20% fee for ships using Strait of Hormuz, Trump says

business.title: Walmart Seeks Bloomfield Delivery Depot
business.latest_developments: Walmart's development team presented plans for a last-mile e-commerce delivery depot to the Pittsburgh Zoning Board of Adjustment, drawing organized neighborhood opposition.
business.summary: Walmart wants to build a last-mile delivery depot in Pittsburgh's Bloomfield neighborhood and made its case before the city Zoning Board of Adjustment, where residents pushed back, setting up what could be an uphill approval fight.

sources.title: Walmart makes the case for a Bloomfield e-commerce depot against neighborhood opposition

business.title: Pittsburgh Ranks High for Single Women Buyers
business.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette reported Pittsburgh stands among the nation's top markets for single women buying homes.
business.summary: A Post-Gazette analysis found Pittsburgh's relatively affordable housing makes it one of the country's leading markets for single female homebuyers, a group reshaping demand in the region's development market.

sources.title: Why Pittsburgh is among the nation's top markets for single female homebuyers

around_town.title: Parkway East Bridge Demolition Underway
around_town.latest_developments: Crews began tearing down the old Commercial Street Bridge deck and PennDOT held its first project update as the 25-day Parkway East (I-376) closure entered its first full workweek.
around_town.summary: PennDOT closed the Parkway East (I-376) for 25 days to replace the Commercial Street Bridge, forcing roughly 100,000 daily drivers onto detours; crews are demolishing the old deck before sliding the new span into place, and drivers can track conditions through the state's 511PA tool.

around_town.title: Homewood Pool Reopens After Overhaul
around_town.latest_developments: On July 10, City of Pittsburgh officials and Homewood residents opened the brand-new Homewood Pool, the centerpiece of a $22.87 million park transformation, just ahead of the returning heat.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh reopened the rebuilt Homewood Pool as part of a $22.87 million overhaul of Homewood Park, giving the neighborhood a place to cool off as another heat dome pushes into Western Pennsylvania this week.

sources.title: Homewood Pool Reopens As Part of Park Transformation Project

around_town.title: Pittsburgh Researchers Fight Grant-Review Changes
around_town.latest_developments: Researchers at the University of Pittsburgh and Carnegie Mellon University publicly criticized proposed federal changes to how research grants get reviewed.
around_town.summary: Scientists at the University of Pittsburgh and Carnegie Mellon warned that the federal government's proposed overhaul of grant-review procedures threatens the flow of research funding that anchors the region's universities and hospitals.

sources.title: Pittsburgh researchers slam proposed changes to federal grant reviews

events.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette profiled Bloop, a growing grassroots museum of vintage technology in Penn Hills.
events.summary: Bloop, a grassroots museum in Penn Hills, collects and displays vintage computers and consumer technology, giving Pittsburgh-area visitors a hands-on look at obsolete gadgets.

around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette video asked whether tackle Troy Fautanu, center Zach Frazier, and linebacker Payton Wilson have played well enough to warrant contract extensions as camp nears.
around_teams.summary: The Steelers face looming decisions on three of their recent draftees—offensive tackle Troy Fautanu, center Zach Frazier, and linebacker Payton Wilson—and a Post-Gazette video weighed whether each has earned an extension before the 2026 season.

around_teams.title: Pirates' Revamped Offense Fuels Optimism
around_teams.latest_developments: Heading out of the All-Star break, Pirates writers describe a clubhouse eager for the second half behind an overhauled lineup that has already topped last year's home run total.
around_teams.summary: The Post-Gazette and TribLive report the Pirates' revamped offense—featuring Ryan O'Hearn, Brandon Lowe, and young slugger Esmerlyn Valdez—has energized the clubhouse, with the team resolving not to fade from the National League Central and wild-card chase.

team_usa.summary: The United States women's national team will play a pair of October friendlies at home against Spain, the top-ranked side and defending World Cup winner, a marquee test as the program builds toward its next cycle.
